description: Canonical (machine-readable) brain filing rules, matched 1:1 to skills/gbrain-curtis-v2.pack.yaml — one rule per declared path prefix (A7/A14: pack + RESOLVER.md + this file change in ONE commit). The .md companion is the human explainer; this JSON is what `gbrain check-resolvable`/filing-audit validates skill writes_to: lists against, and what archive-crawler reads at runtime.

rules.description: A page whose primary subject is one person.
A page whose primary subject is one company or organization.
Product pages (company type, subtype product).
Non-company org pages (company type, subtype org).
A page whose primary subject is a financing or M&A transaction.
A meeting transcript or minutes. Propagate entities to companies/ and people/ pages.
Calendar events, date-keyed; attendees cross-linked to people/. Replaces retired cal/ and daily/calendar/.
Email captures. Replaces the retired correspondence/ prefix.
Slack captures.
Tweet/thread captures.
Equivalent prefix for tweet type; prefer tweets/ for new pages.
Cron-generated social digests.
External content where the source format is the unifying frame. External essay-shaped content goes to media lanes, never writing/.
Video content (media type, subtype video).
Article content (media type, subtype article). inbox-triage promotion target.
Essay content (media type, subtype essay).
Book content (media type, subtype book).
Podcast content (media type, subtype podcast).
Blog content (media type, subtype blog).
Post content (media type, subtype blog). KEPT per Curtis 2026-07-10.
Sanctioned synthesis exception (book-mirror output). Pages here stamp type: synthesis in frontmatter; raw book ingest goes to books/.
Sanctioned synthesis exception (article personalization/enrichment output). Pages here stamp type: synthesis; raw article ingest goes to articles/.
ONLY raw data feeding multiple pages — see sources_dir below.
Imported chat exports where the conversation is the artifact (source type, subtype conversation).
Voice-note transcript holders (source type, subtype voice-note). Derived content routes via the RESOLVER lane test.
Dated investigation products. perplexity-research and academic-verify file HERE (research/ and agent/ RETIRED); author via source: frontmatter.
A falsifiable position someone holds over time, expected to be scored.
Actionable candidates. stage: frontmatter is a MIRROR; the kanban card owns work state.
Reusable reference knowledge. Guides carry frontmatter kind: guide (guides/ RETIRED).

examples: major decision records with alternatives + kill-criteria
rules.description: MAJOR decisions only. EVERY decision is first a dated timeline entry (DECISION HH:MM+nonce) on its SUBJECT page. See RESOLVER.md §Decision system.
Project ENTITY pages only. Strategy/roadmap documents go to analysis/ or concepts/, linked FROM the project page.
EXTERNAL tech as page SUBJECT only (softened from v3.5 'any repo always'). Internal architecture → projects/<repo> + concepts (domain: hermes).
Personal-life content — kept separate from work.
SAVE-GUARD (LAW): ONLY Curtis-authored or Curtis-commissioned prose. External essay-shaped content → media/ lanes or concepts/.
The dream cycle's lane for Curtis-original thinking (writing type, subtype original). Same save-guard as writing/.
Annotation atoms (origin subtypes: extraction/manual/lore).
Catch-all. Declared LAST in the pack — never shadows real lanes.
Inbox drawer (note type, subtype inbox). inbox-triage promotes OUT via the lane test.
Archive drawer (note type, subtype archive).
Prompts drawer (note type, subtype prompts).
Programs drawer (note type, subtype programs).
Org drawer (note type, subtype org). Distinct from orgs/ (company).
Hiring drawer (note type, subtype hiring).
Household drawer (note type, subtype household).
Finance drawer (note type, subtype finance).
MACHINE LANE — dream orchestrator only. Humans and agents never file here.

frontmatter_only_types.description: Stamped type: code by the gbrain-code hook (no path lane).
Stamped type: image by media tooling (no path lane).
Sui-generis synthesized output (book mirrors, personalized reads) at media/<format>/ paths with stamped type: synthesis. The narrow sanctioned exception to file-by-primary-subject.

retired_directories.description: Prefixes that MUST NOT receive new pages. Writers listed are retargeted (Phase 2 of the 2026-07-11 implementation).

entries.goes_to: NOWHERE — tasks live in kanban; op logs stay out of the brain
FENCED OUT — never a knowledge lane

sources_dir.purpose: ONLY for raw data: bulk imports, API dumps, periodic captures. A page with a clear primary subject (person, company, concept) does NOT belong here.

notes: The PRIMARY SUBJECT of the content determines the directory, not the format or source skill.
The lane test in RESOLVER.md §The lanes is authoritative for writing/ vs theses/ vs ideas/ vs analysis/ vs concepts/.
When in doubt: what would you search for to find this page again?
Cross-link from related directories via back-links — do not duplicate content.
Tasks NEVER live in the brain — kanban cards own work state.

dream_synthesize_paths.description: Single source of truth for the v0.23 dream-cycle synthesize/patterns trusted-workspace allow-list. The cycle's synthesize phase reads this list and threads it as `allowed_slug_prefixes` to every subagent it dispatches; put_page enforces it server-side. Editing this list is the ONLY way to add a new directory the synthesis subagent may write to. This allowlist — not any pack prefix — is the wiki-guard invariant (A13).
